title: Baba Main Hussain Da Ki Haal Sunaawaan
body:
Sani)
Sun Baba dasween nu veer laashaan chukda kinj bharda sa haanwaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Khaak tay beh Kay vayn paanda si veer mera aay kehnda jaanda si
Menu bhuldiyan nae Zainab teer khawan wailay Asghar di adaawaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Bara okha oh baba waila si zeen toun latheya si jado Ghazi
Bhaina day kol aa kay roya Shabbir bara chum chum Kay ridawaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Kholeya khaimay aakay gathri nu keya Shabbir ro Kay Ferwa nu
Koi reh geya jay Ferwa rait ander tukra Main labh Kay leyawaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Dar e Khaima tay aakay veer mera Boleya seena waikh Akbar da
Das Zainab Laila toun kiwain Main Akbar day seenay nu chupawaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Jado Zakhmi hoi odhi gardan nehar day paasay waikh Kay veeran
Ghazi da na lay Kay akhri vayn kita wich ukhriyan saawaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Shimar khanjar day war kerda si veer tasbeeh khuda di perhda si
Tera zarbaan day nal shimar nay gin gin Kay odi katiyan nay saawaan..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Keya Saqlain shah nay khaliq nu waqt e zibh e azeem aawee tu
Rab akheya arshaa tou Tera karbal aala lakh war Main aawaan..
